senses.en: Long narrow bands differing in colour from the surrounding surface

ex.en: My favourite shirt has blue stripes across the front.
Researchers investigate how zebra stripes may discourage biting insects, potentially revealing useful strategies for protecting livestock.

col: black and white stripes｜sọc đen trắng
tip: stripes là số nhiều của stripe; tính từ “có sọc” là striped.

senses.zh: biên tập viên; tổng biên tập
senses.en: someone who prepares written material or manages a publication
someone who selects and arranges recorded images or sound
software used to change digital content

ex.en: The editor suggested a clearer ending for my story.
A newspaper editor must balance the public's right to information with respect for individual privacy.

col: text editor｜trình soạn thảo văn bản
editor of a magazine｜biên tập viên tạp chí
tip: editor có thể chỉ người biên tập, cũng có thể chỉ phần mềm soạn thảo.

senses.en: Something made by combining two or more different things.

ex.en: Stir the mixture until it becomes smooth and creamy.
Successful cities offer a mixture of affordable housing, reliable transport, and accessible public spaces.

col: a mixture of｜một hỗn hợp của
a rich mixture｜một sự kết hợp phong phú
tip: a mixture of có thể đi với chất liệu, cũng có thể đi với những thứ trừu tượng như cảm xúc.

senses.en: To make something happen later than expected or planned.

senses.zh: sự chậm trễ; thời gian chờ
senses.en: A period of waiting before something happens or continues.

ex.en: Heavy snow delayed our flight until the next morning.
Delays in public transport can reduce productivity and discourage people from leaving their cars at home.

col: delay a decision｜hoãn một quyết định
a lengthy delay｜sự chậm trễ kéo dài
without delay｜ngay lập tức; không chậm trễ
delay doing something｜hoãn làm việc gì
tip: Sau động từ dùng V-ing: delay doing, không dùng to do.

senses.en: The sound or action of laughing

ex.en: Laughter filled the kitchen when the puppy sneezed.
Shared laughter can strengthen social bonds and help people manage stress in demanding work environments.

col: a burst of laughter｜một tràng cười
tip: laughter không đếm được; “một tràng cười” là a burst of laughter.

senses.en: To remove hair from skin using a razor.

senses.zh: gọt mỏng; cắt giảm chút ít
senses.en: To remove thin pieces or reduce something by a small amount.

senses.zh: sự cạo râu; việc cạo mặt
senses.en: An act of removing facial hair with a razor.

ex.en: I shave every morning before leaving for work.
Improved transport connections could shave several minutes off daily journeys and encourage more people to commute by train.

col: shave time off｜rút ngắn thời gian
tip: Quá khứ là shaved; quá khứ phân từ là shaved hoặc shaven.

senses.en: To become curved or make something curved.
To move your body downwards or forwards from the waist.
A curved section of a road, river, or other long object.

ex.en: Bend the wire gently to make a small hook.
Drivers should reduce their speed before approaching a sharp bend, especially when road conditions are poor.

col: bend the rules｜du di quy tắc
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là bent; bend down nghĩa là cúi xuống.

senses.en: a young sheep
meat from a young sheep, eaten as food

ex.en: A small lamb followed its mother across the field.
Producing lamb requires land and water, so its environmental impact should be considered when planning sustainable diets.

tip: Chữ b cuối không đọc; chỉ con vật thì đếm được, chỉ thịt thì không đếm được.

senses.zh: niềm tự hào; sự hãnh diện
senses.en: Pleasure and satisfaction in achievements, qualities, or people you value.

senses.zh: lòng tự trọng; tính tự phụ
senses.en: Respect for yourself, sometimes involving an exaggerated sense of importance.
To feel especially pleased about your own qualities or achievements.

ex.en: Her face shone with pride as she displayed her painting.
Schools can foster community pride by encouraging students to participate in projects that improve their local environment.

col: a sense of pride｜cảm giác tự hào
hurt someone's pride｜làm tổn thương lòng tự trọng của ai
pride yourself on｜tự hào về bản thân ở điều gì
tip: Động từ dùng pride oneself on; tính từ dùng proud of.

senses.en: a soft hat, often with a stiff front part
a cover fitted over the end or opening of something
to set a maximum amount or level for something

ex.en: He pulled on his cap before leaving for practice.
Governments could cap annual rent increases to protect households from sudden rises in housing costs.

col: baseball cap｜mũ lưỡi trai bóng chày
a cap on fees｜mức trần phí
tip: Làm động từ, cap nghĩa là đặt mức trần; a cap on + khoản bị giới hạn.

senses.en: An event causing great damage, suffering, or loss.

senses.zh: sự thất bại hoàn toàn; chuyện tồi tệ
senses.en: Something that goes extremely badly or fails completely.

ex.en: Dinner was a disaster because I burned the rice.
Effective early warning systems can reduce the damage caused by natural disasters and help communities recover more quickly.

col: a complete disaster｜một thất bại hoàn toàn
tip: Cũng dùng khoa trương để chê sự thất bại: The party was a disaster.

senses.en: A juicy fruit with fuzzy skin and a large hard stone
Having a pale pinkish orange colour

ex.en: She sliced a ripe peach into her breakfast bowl.
Peach growers may face reduced harvests when unusually warm winters disrupt the trees' natural flowering cycle.

tip: Hạt đào trong tiếng Anh–Anh thường gọi là stone, trong tiếng Anh–Mỹ thường gọi là pit.

senses.en: someone who enters a building illegally to steal things

ex.en: A burglar climbed through the window while everyone was away.
Improved street lighting and secure doors may discourage burglars from targeting homes in residential areas.

col: deter burglars｜ngăn chặn trộm đột nhập
catch a burglar｜bắt được tên trộm
tip: burglar là kẻ đột nhập; robber thường là kẻ cướp có đe dọa.

senses.en: A person who sends a message, letter or package.

ex.en: The sender wrapped the parcel carefully before posting it.
Email users should verify the sender before opening attachments to reduce the risk of digital fraud.

col: the sender's address｜địa chỉ người gửi
return to sender｜trả lại người gửi
an unknown sender｜người gửi không rõ
tip: sender là người gửi, recipient là người nhận.

senses.en: a plant grown in large quantities for food or other uses

senses.zh: vụ mùa; sản lượng thu hoạch
senses.en: the amount of a plant harvested at one time
to remove outer parts of an image or cut hair short

ex.en: The farmer checked his wheat crop after the storm.
Rising temperatures may reduce crop yields, threatening food security in regions that already experience water shortages.

col: a bumper crop｜vụ mùa bội thu
crop a photo｜cắt xén một bức ảnh
tip: crop vừa là cây trồng vừa là vụ thu hoạch; động từ có thể là cắt xén ảnh.

senses.zh: gây ấn tượng; làm khâm phục
senses.en: to make someone admire or respect someone or something

senses.zh: khắc sâu; làm nhận ra tầm quan trọng
senses.en: to make someone understand how important something is

ex.en: Her homemade bread impressed everyone at the family dinner.
Applicants can impress potential employers by explaining how their practical experience matches the requirements of the role.

col: impress someone with｜gây ấn tượng với ai bằng
be impressed by｜có ấn tượng với
impress upon someone｜làm ai ghi nhớ
tip: impressed mô tả cảm giác của người; impressive mô tả sự việc đáng ngưỡng mộ.

senses.en: To go somewhere and bring someone or something back.
To be sold for a particular amount of money.

ex.en: Could you fetch my jacket from the bedroom?
Homes near reliable public transport often fetch higher prices because buyers value convenient access to employment.

col: fetch some water｜đi lấy ít nước
fetch someone from school｜đón ai ở trường
fetch a high price｜bán được giá cao
tip: fetch nhấn mạnh đi lấy rồi mang về; bring chỉ là mang đến.

senses.en: A small item worn to show identity, membership, or achievement.

ex.en: She pinned her new badge onto her jacket.
Requiring visitors to wear a visible badge can improve security in schools and other public buildings.

col: a badge of honour｜biểu tượng vinh dự
tip: Thường chỉ huy hiệu nhỏ đeo trên người; huy chương thường dùng medal.

senses.en: To become ice or make something extremely cold and solid.
To stop something changing or being used temporarily.
To stop moving suddenly because of fear or surprise.

ex.en: Freeze the leftover soup and eat it next week.
Governments may freeze public transport fares to reduce financial pressure on households during economic downturns.

col: freeze with fear｜đứng khựng vì sợ
tip: Quá khứ là froze, quá khứ phân từ là frozen.

senses.en: The authority or place checking goods entering a country
Taxes charged on goods brought into a country
Traditional practices shared by a community or social group

ex.en: We opened our suitcases for inspection at customs.
More efficient customs procedures can reduce delays at borders and support international trade without weakening security.

tip: Nghĩa hải quan luôn giữ chữ s; custom ở số ít không có nghĩa hải quan.

senses.en: A shop or hospital department that prepares and supplies medicines.
The study and practice of preparing and supplying medicines.

ex.en: I collected my medicine from the pharmacy after lunch.
A community pharmacy can improve access to healthcare by offering professional advice close to people's homes.

tip: Hiệu thuốc là danh từ đếm được; ngành dược thì không đếm được; dược sĩ là pharmacist.

senses.en: A man who is in charge of a school.

ex.en: The headmaster welcomed new pupils at the school gate.
The headmaster introduced a mentoring programme to help younger pupils develop confidence and settle into school life.

tip: Chỉ nam; tiếng Anh–Anh dùng headteacher không phân biệt giới, tiếng Anh–Mỹ thường dùng principal.

senses.zh: chu đáo; quan tâm đến người khác
senses.en: kind and concerned about other people's needs
the work of looking after people who need help

ex.en: Our caring neighbour brought soup when I was ill.
A caring school environment can improve children's confidence and encourage them to seek help when needed.

col: a caring attitude｜thái độ quan tâm
a caring environment｜môi trường đầy sự quan tâm
tip: caring nghĩa là quan tâm đến người khác; careful nghĩa là làm việc cẩn thận.

senses.en: Finding a total by adding equal groups together.

senses.zh: sự gia tăng nhanh; sự sinh sôi
senses.en: An increase in quantity, often through repeated reproduction.

ex.en: We practised multiplication by arranging buttons in equal rows.
A strong understanding of multiplication helps children develop the mathematical skills needed for science and financial literacy.

tip: Phép nhân dùng multiplication; “nhân với” có thể dùng multiplied by.

senses.en: To find someone or something unpleasant or not enjoyable.
A feeling of not liking someone or something.

ex.en: I dislike waiting outside when it is raining.
Some students dislike group assignments because they feel that individual contributions are not assessed fairly.

col: dislike doing something｜không thích làm việc gì
a strong dislike of｜sự ác cảm mạnh với
take a dislike to｜bắt đầu ghét
tip: Sau dislike dùng danh từ hoặc V-ing: dislike waiting.

senses.en: an educational talk given to an audience, especially university students
to give an educational talk to an audience
to criticize someone at length about their behaviour

ex.en: I stayed after the lecture to ask a question.
Universities should combine traditional lectures with practical activities that encourage students to apply their knowledge.

col: attend a lecture｜nghe một buổi giảng
lecture on biology｜giảng về sinh học
lecture someone about｜răn dạy ai về
tip: lecture on + chủ đề là giảng về điều gì; lecture someone có thể nghĩa là răn dạy.

senses.en: Food placed inside a pie, sandwich, or similar item.
Material used to repair a hole in a tooth.
Making you feel full after eating.

ex.en: This pie has a warm apple and cinnamon filling.
School lunches should offer filling meals that provide sufficient nutrients to support children's growth and concentration.

col: a filling meal｜một bữa ăn no bụng
tip: Làm tính từ nói thức ăn làm no bụng, không phải người đã no.

senses.en: To respect someone for their qualities or achievements
To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive

ex.en: I admire my sister for staying calm under pressure.
People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.

col: admire someone for something｜ngưỡng mộ ai vì điều gì
admire the view｜chiêm ngưỡng cảnh đẹp
tip: admire sb for sth: ngưỡng mộ ai vì điều gì.

senses.en: The physical state of someone or something
A requirement, or circumstances affecting life or activity
A medical problem affecting someone's health

ex.en: Despite its age, this bicycle is in excellent condition.
Improving working conditions can increase employee satisfaction and reduce the number of people leaving their jobs.

col: in good condition｜trong tình trạng tốt
on condition that｜với điều kiện là
tip: Chỉ trạng thái thì thường không đếm được; chỉ điều kiện làm việc, sống thì hay dùng số nhiều.

senses.en: not joined, shared, or considered together
to divide things or move them apart

ex.en: We keep clean towels in a separate cupboard.
Local authorities should provide separate bins for recyclable materials to make household waste sorting easier.

tip: Tính từ đọc đuôi /ət/, động từ đọc đuôi /eɪt/.

senses.en: not mixed with other substances
complete and containing nothing of a different kind
concerned with theory rather than practical uses

ex.en: This soft scarf is made from pure wool.
Investment in pure science can lead to unexpected discoveries with important practical applications decades later.

tip: pure vừa nghĩa là không pha tạp, vừa dùng để nhấn mạnh, như pure luck.

senses.en: Open your mouth widely and breathe deeply from tiredness or boredom.
An involuntary wide opening of the mouth with a deep breath.

ex.en: I yawned twice while waiting for the kettle to boil.
Students who regularly yawn during morning lessons may not be getting enough sleep at night.

col: stifle a yawn｜nén một cái ngáp
tip: Có thể nói yawn hoặc give a yawn.

senses.en: a small pepper with a strong, hot taste

senses.zh: món chili con carne (thịt, đậu cay)
senses.en: a spicy dish usually made with meat, beans, and tomatoes

ex.en: Add one chopped chilli if you like spicy food.
Farmers growing chilli peppers may need reliable irrigation systems as rising temperatures increase water demand.

tip: Tiếng Anh–Anh viết chilli, tiếng Anh–Mỹ thường viết chili.

senses.en: Fully grown and ready to eat or harvest
Ready for a particular action or development

ex.en: These ripe peaches smell wonderful and taste very sweet.
With public support growing, the time is ripe for governments to invest more in renewable energy.

col: ripe for change｜sẵn sàng cho sự thay đổi
the time is ripe｜thời cơ đã chín muồi
tip: Trái cây chín dùng ripe; người trưởng thành, chín chắn thường dùng mature.

senses.en: having a strong, unpleasant smell

ex.en: Please leave those stinky shoes outside the front door.
Residents often describe neglected rubbish bins as stinky, highlighting how poor waste collection affects daily life.

tip: Là từ không trang trọng; trong văn viết nghiêm túc có thể dùng foul-smelling.

senses.en: Having a natural ability to do something very well.

ex.en: My talented cousin painted this beautiful picture of our garden.
Schools should provide opportunities for talented students to develop their abilities beyond the standard curriculum.

col: a talented musician｜một nhạc sĩ tài năng
a talented artist｜một nghệ sĩ tài năng
tip: talented nhấn mạnh năng khiếu bẩm sinh; skilled nhấn mạnh kỹ năng thành thạo.

senses.en: unhappy because someone has something you want
upset because someone you love shows interest in another person

ex.en: I felt jealous when my cousin got a bicycle.
Social media can make users jealous of others whose lives appear more successful or exciting.

col: jealous of someone｜ghen tị với ai
a jealous partner｜người yêu hay ghen
tip: Thường dùng be jealous of; vừa nghĩa là ghen tị vừa nghĩa là ghen tuông.

senses.en: an edible seed that grows underground inside a thin shell
a very small amount of money, expressed as peanuts

ex.en: She cracked the shell and ate the peanut inside.
Schools should consider peanut allergies when planning meals to ensure that all children can eat safely.

col: work for peanuts｜làm việc với đồng lương còm cõi
tip: Nghĩa “số tiền rất ít” dùng số nhiều peanuts, mang tính không trang trọng.

senses.zh: thuộc pháp luật; về mặt pháp lý
senses.en: Relating to laws or the system that applies them

senses.zh: hợp pháp; được luật cho phép
senses.en: Allowed by the law

ex.en: We sought legal advice before signing the rental agreement.
Access to affordable legal services is essential for ensuring that disadvantaged citizens can defend their rights.

tip: legal có thể chỉ liên quan đến luật, không nhất thiết nghĩa là hợp pháp.

senses.en: A set of tools or equipment for a particular activity
A set of parts used to build something

ex.en: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
Schools should provide basic science kits so that all pupils can take part in practical experiments.

col: repair kit｜bộ dụng cụ sửa chữa
kit someone out｜trang bị đầy đủ cho ai
tip: kit là bộ đồ dùng; kit sb out là trang bị đầy đủ cho ai.

senses.en: At or to a greater distance.
Located at a greater distance.

ex.en: We walked farther along the beach before stopping for lunch.
As housing costs rise, many workers move farther from city centres and face longer daily commutes.

col: farther north｜xa hơn về phía bắc
tip: farther chủ yếu chỉ khoảng cách thực; “thêm nữa” khi bàn luận thì dùng further.

senses.en: a woman who rents property or rooms to other people
a woman who owns or manages a pub

ex.en: Our landlady came round to fix the kitchen tap.
A responsible landlady should maintain safe housing conditions and respond promptly when tenants report serious problems.

col: ask the landlady｜hỏi bà chủ nhà
pay rent to the landlady｜trả tiền thuê cho bà chủ nhà
tip: landlady chỉ nữ; landlord có thể dùng chung cho chủ nhà.

senses.en: A woman who welcomes and entertains guests.
A woman who welcomes customers and takes them to restaurant tables.

ex.en: Our hostess brought out fresh fruit after dinner.
A welcoming hostess can help international visitors feel comfortable and encourage meaningful conversations across cultures.

col: a gracious hostess｜một nữ chủ nhà duyên dáng
the perfect hostess｜nữ chủ nhà hoàn hảo
restaurant hostess｜tiếp tân nữ nhà hàng
tip: hostess chỉ nữ; host ngày nay cũng dùng cho mọi giới.

senses.en: relaxed and not easily upset or worried

ex.en: Our easy-going neighbour never complains when our dog barks.
Although an easy-going management style can reduce workplace stress, clear expectations remain essential for maintaining productivity.

col: an easy-going personality｜tính cách dễ tính
an easy-going attitude｜thái độ thoải mái
an easy-going manner｜phong thái dễ gần
tip: Chỉ tính tình dễ chịu, khó nổi nóng, không có nghĩa là lười.

senses.en: Not speaking or choosing not to speak.
Making no sound or containing no noise.
Written in a word but not pronounced.

ex.en: He remained silent while his sister explained the problem.
Employees may remain silent about workplace problems if they fear losing their jobs.

tip: silent nhấn mạnh không phát ra tiếng; quiet có thể nghĩa là tiếng nhỏ.

senses.en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: An enormous pumpkin filled the basket on our kitchen table.
Rapid urban growth places enormous pressure on housing, transport networks, and other essential public services.

col: an enormous amount of｜một lượng lớn
tip: Dùng được cho kích thước, cũng dùng cho áp lực, số lượng hoặc ảnh hưởng rất lớn.

senses.zh: sự sắp xếp; việc chuẩn bị
senses.en: A plan or preparation for something that will happen.

senses.zh: cách bố trí; sự sắp đặt
senses.en: The way objects are positioned or organised.
An agreement about how something will be done.

ex.en: We made arrangements for someone to feed the cat.
Flexible working arrangements can help parents balance professional responsibilities with the demands of family life.

col: come to an arrangement｜đạt được thỏa thuận
tip: Chỉ việc chuẩn bị cụ thể thì thường dùng số nhiều: make arrangements for.

senses.zh: kỹ thuật; phương pháp; thủ pháp
senses.en: A particular way of doing something, often requiring skill.
The skill someone shows when performing a particular activity.

ex.en: The coach showed me a better technique for swimming.
Teachers can use a range of assessment techniques to identify learning difficulties before students fall behind.

col: a technique for doing something｜phương pháp làm việc gì
improve your technique｜nâng cao tay nghề
tip: technique nhấn mạnh phương pháp cụ thể; technology là công nghệ.

senses.en: to put something down carefully or arrange it flat
to produce eggs from the body

senses.zh: không chuyên; không thuộc giới tu sĩ
senses.en: not professionally trained in a subject or ordained in religion

ex.en: Please lay the clean towels on the bathroom shelf.
Investment in early childhood education can lay the foundations for a more skilled and adaptable workforce.

tip: “Đặt” chia lay – laid – laid; “nằm” là lie – lay – lain.

senses.en: A remark expressing admiration or approval.
To tell someone that you admire something about them.

ex.en: Her compliment about my cooking made me smile.
Teachers who compliment students on specific improvements can strengthen motivation and encourage continued effort.

col: compliment someone on something｜khen ai về điều gì
accept a compliment｜đón nhận lời khen
a sincere compliment｜lời khen chân thành
tip: compliment là lời khen; complement là sự bổ sung, bổ trợ cho nhau.

senses.zh: tiền hoàn lại; khoản hoàn trả
senses.en: Money returned after a purchase or an overpayment.
To return money paid for something.

ex.en: The shop gave me a refund for the broken kettle.
Airlines should offer passengers a full refund when flights are cancelled without reasonable alternatives.

col: a full refund｜hoàn tiền toàn bộ
request a refund｜yêu cầu hoàn tiền
refund the cost｜hoàn lại chi phí
tip: Danh từ nhấn âm đầu; động từ đọc /rɪˈfʌnd/, nhấn âm sau.

senses.zh: thể dục dụng cụ; thể dục
senses.en: A sport involving controlled movements that develop strength, balance, and flexibility.

ex.en: My sister practises gymnastics at the local sports centre.
Including gymnastics in school programmes can help children develop coordination, physical confidence, and an interest in exercise.

col: do gymnastics｜tập thể dục dụng cụ
artistic gymnastics｜thể dục dụng cụ nghệ thuật
tip: Dù kết thúc bằng -s, khi chỉ môn thể thao thì dùng như số ít: gymnastics is.

senses.en: The ability or authority to control people, events, or decisions.
Energy used to make machines and equipment work.
To supply energy that makes something work.

ex.en: The manager has the power to change our shifts.
Solar panels can power rural schools while reducing their dependence on expensive and unreliable fuel supplies.

col: renewable power｜điện từ năng lượng tái tạo
power supply｜nguồn điện; cung cấp điện
the power to decide｜quyền quyết định
tip: Có quyền làm gì dùng have the power to do.

senses.zh: podcast; chương trình âm thanh trực tuyến
senses.en: An online audio programme available to stream or download.

senses.zh: sản xuất và phát hành podcast
senses.en: To produce and distribute an online audio programme.

ex.en: I listen to a cooking podcast while making dinner.
Educational podcasts allow learners to explore complex subjects while travelling or completing routine household tasks.

col: host a podcast｜dẫn một chương trình podcast
subscribe to a podcast｜đăng ký theo dõi podcast
tip: Nghe podcast dùng listen to a podcast, đừng bỏ to.

senses.zh: rất nhiều; ở mức độ lớn
senses.en: To a great degree or in large amounts.
With great weight, force, or effort.

ex.en: It rained heavily while we waited for the bus.
Countries that rely heavily on imported fuel are particularly vulnerable to sudden changes in global energy prices.

col: rely heavily on｜phụ thuộc nhiều vào
invest heavily in｜đầu tư mạnh vào
tip: Nói mưa to dùng rain heavily, không dùng rain strongly.

senses.en: A large container for holding liquids or gases.
A heavily protected military vehicle that moves on tracks.

ex.en: The fish swam behind a rock in the tank.
Installing a rainwater tank allows households to water gardens without relying entirely on treated drinking water.

col: fill the tank｜đổ đầy bình xăng
tip: fish tank là bể cá; bình xăng ô tô là fuel tank.

senses.en: to understand someone's words, actions, or intentions incorrectly

ex.en: Please don't misunderstand me; I really want to help.
Patients may misunderstand medical advice when professionals use technical language rather than clear explanations suited to their audience.

col: misunderstand someone's intentions｜hiểu lầm ý định của ai
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là misunderstood.

senses.en: Related to the simplest or first stages of learning.
Relating to the first years of formal school education.

ex.en: This course teaches elementary cooking skills to complete beginners.
Elementary education should develop children's curiosity as well as their ability to read and calculate.

tip: elementary school chủ yếu dùng trong tiếng Anh–Mỹ; tiếng Anh–Anh thường dùng primary school.

senses.en: In, from, or relating to the west of an area.

senses.zh: thuộc phương Tây (châu Âu, Bắc Mỹ…)
senses.en: Relating to Europe, North America, and their associated cultures.

senses.zh: phim cao bồi miền Tây; truyện miền Tây
senses.en: A film or story about the historical American West.

ex.en: Our cabin faces the lake on its western shore.
Investment in western regions could improve transport links and reduce economic inequalities within the country.

col: the western coast｜bờ biển phía tây
a western film｜một bộ phim cao bồi miền Tây
tip: Khi chỉ các nước hoặc nền văn hóa phương Tây thường viết hoa: Western.

senses.en: An area with a particular purpose, feature, or condition.
Officially assign land to a particular use.

ex.en: Cars are not allowed inside this quiet pedestrian zone.
Creating a low-emission zone can reduce air pollution, provided that affordable public transport is available.

col: a pedestrian zone｜khu vực dành cho người đi bộ
zone land for housing｜quy hoạch đất làm nhà ở
tip: zone nhấn mạnh khu vực có mục đích hoặc đặc điểm riêng; area rộng nghĩa hơn.

senses.en: A strong metal used in construction and needed by the body.
A tool with a heated base for smoothing clothes.
To make clothes smooth using a heated iron.

ex.en: These old iron gates are too heavy to lift.
A diet containing sufficient iron can help prevent anaemia, particularly among children and pregnant women.

col: iron a shirt｜ủi áo sơ mi
tip: Sắt không đếm được; bàn là đếm được: an iron.

senses.en: an act of changing position or moving the body
an organised effort by people seeking shared social change
one main section of a long piece of music

ex.en: A sudden movement in the bushes caught my attention.
The environmental movement has encouraged governments to adopt stronger policies on waste reduction and renewable energy.

col: freedom of movement｜tự do đi lại
environmental movement｜phong trào bảo vệ môi trường
tip: Chỉ động tác cụ thể hay phong trào thì đếm được; nghĩa di chuyển nói chung có thể không đếm được.

senses.en: containing different types of things or people

senses.zh: lẫn lộn; vừa tốt vừa xấu
senses.en: including both positive and negative feelings, opinions, or results

ex.en: I bought a bag of mixed nuts for our picnic.
The introduction of online lessons received mixed reactions from students, parents, and teachers.

col: mixed results｜kết quả tốt xấu lẫn lộn
tip: mixed feelings là cảm xúc mâu thuẫn; mixed cũng là quá khứ phân từ của mix.

senses.en: A liquid measure of about half a litre.

ex.en: Please add a pint of milk to the bowl.
Consumers comparing international recipes should note that a British pint is larger than an American pint.

col: a pint of milk｜một panh sữa
tip: Panh Anh khoảng 568 ml, panh lỏng của Mỹ khoảng 473 ml.

senses.en: separated by distance or time; not together
into separate pieces
except for something being considered

ex.en: We planted the young trees two metres apart.
Living apart from their families can make international students more independent, but may also cause loneliness.

tip: apart from có thể là “ngoại trừ” hoặc “ngoài ra còn”, tùy ngữ cảnh.

senses.en: Someone with extensive knowledge or skill in a particular subject.
Having or showing great knowledge or skill.

ex.en: We asked an expert to examine the old painting.
Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.

tip: expert on/in + lĩnh vực nghĩa là chuyên gia về lĩnh vực đó.

senses.en: similar in appearance or character
in the same way, or equally for both groups

ex.en: These two jackets look alike, but one feels warmer.
Public parks benefit children and adults alike by providing accessible spaces for exercise and relaxation.

col: treat everyone alike｜đối xử với mọi người như nhau
tip: Tính từ thường đứng sau động từ nối, không đứng trước danh từ.

senses.zh: buổi lễ ăn mừng; lễ kỷ niệm
senses.en: A special event held to mark a happy occasion.
The act of showing happiness about something special.

ex.en: We decorated the garden for our grandparents' anniversary celebration.
Community celebrations can strengthen social bonds by bringing together residents from different cultural backgrounds.

col: hold a celebration｜tổ chức một buổi ăn mừng
tip: Chỉ sự kiện cụ thể thì đếm được; chỉ hành động ăn mừng thì không đếm được.

senses.en: A flat shape with three straight sides and three angles.
A triangular metal musical instrument struck with a small metal stick.

ex.en: Fold the paper into a triangle before cutting it.
Engineers often use triangles in bridge designs because these shapes provide strength without requiring excessive material.

tip: Tiếng Anh–Anh nói right-angled triangle; tiếng Anh–Mỹ hay nói right triangle.

senses.en: A sour liquid used to flavour or preserve food.

ex.en: Add a little vinegar to the salad dressing.
Traditional food preservation methods often use vinegar to slow bacterial growth and extend the storage life of vegetables.

col: a splash of vinegar｜một chút giấm
tip: Thường không đếm được; có thể nói a bottle of vinegar để chỉ lượng.

senses.en: a visual display of information, often showing comparisons or changes

senses.zh: ghi lại; theo dõi; lập biểu đồ
senses.en: to record or show how something develops over time
a detailed map used for navigation at sea or in air

ex.en: This colourful chart shows how we spend our money.
The chart compares the proportion of commuters using public transport in three different cities.

tip: Biểu đồ là chart; bản đồ thông thường là map; hải đồ cũng gọi là chart.

senses.en: Unpleasantly cold, though usually not extremely cold.
Showing little warmth or friendliness towards someone.

ex.en: It felt chilly outside, so I grabbed my jacket.
Providing warm public spaces during chilly weather can help protect older residents from cold-related illnesses.

col: a chilly morning｜một buổi sáng se lạnh
a chilly reception｜sự tiếp đón lạnh nhạt
tip: chilly nhẹ hơn freezing; cũng dùng để tả thái độ lạnh nhạt.

senses.en: A natural ability to do something well.
People who have strong abilities in a particular field.

ex.en: My cousin has a real talent for drawing animals.
Schools should nurture creative talent alongside academic skills to help students develop a wider range of abilities.

tip: Năng khiếu về điều gì dùng a talent for + danh từ hoặc V-ing.

senses.en: move back up after hitting a surface, or cause this
a movement back up after hitting a surface
be rejected by a bank because funds are insufficient

ex.en: The ball bounced over the fence into our neighbour's garden.
Local businesses can bounce back after economic shocks if they receive timely financial support.

col: a cheque bounces｜séc bị từ chối
bounce ideas off someone｜trao đổi ý tưởng với ai
tip: bounce back vừa là nảy lại, vừa hay dùng với nghĩa hồi phục sau thất bại.

senses.zh: sự thư giãn; sự nghỉ ngơi
senses.en: Rest or enjoyable activity that reduces stress and tension.
The process of muscles becoming less tight.
The act of making rules or restrictions less strict.

ex.en: After work, I enjoy a warm bath for relaxation.
Schools should teach relaxation techniques to help students manage anxiety before important examinations.

col: relaxation of restrictions｜nới lỏng các hạn chế
tip: Nghĩa thư giãn, nghỉ ngơi thường không đếm được: for relaxation.

senses.en: a large sea fish, or its flesh eaten as food

ex.en: I made a tuna sandwich for lunch today.
International cooperation is essential to prevent overfishing and ensure that tuna populations remain healthy for future generations.

tip: Thịt cá không đếm được; chỉ con cá thì số nhiều thường vẫn là tuna.

senses.zh: sự hạ cánh; sự đổ bộ
senses.en: The act of reaching the ground or shore.
A flat area at the top of or between stairs.

ex.en: The plane made a smooth landing despite the wind.
Improved weather forecasting can help pilots prepare for a safe landing during rapidly changing conditions.

col: upstairs landing｜chiếu nghỉ cầu thang tầng trên
tip: Ngoài nghĩa hạ cánh còn chỉ chiếu nghỉ ở đầu hoặc giữa cầu thang.

senses.en: Attractive and fashionable in appearance or design

ex.en: Her stylish green jacket looked great with plain trousers.
Affordable, stylish furniture can encourage young consumers to choose recycled materials for their homes.

col: a stylish design｜thiết kế có phong cách
a stylish interior｜nội thất tinh tế
tip: stylish nhấn mạnh sự thời trang và đẹp mắt, không nhất thiết đắt tiền hay xa hoa.

senses.en: relating to a whole country or its people
a person who is a citizen of a particular country

ex.en: My sister hopes to join the national swimming team.
National policies can help reduce regional differences in access to healthcare and education.

tip: national nhấn mạnh toàn bộ một quốc gia; international là quốc tế.

senses.en: A wind instrument held sideways and played by blowing across it.

ex.en: She practises the flute by her bedroom window every afternoon.
Learning to play the flute can develop concentration and encourage children to participate in musical ensembles.

tip: Tiếng Anh–Anh thường gọi người chơi là flautist; tiếng Anh–Mỹ hay dùng flutist.

senses.en: the inside surface at the top of a room

senses.zh: mức trần; giới hạn tối đa
senses.en: the highest amount or level that is allowed

ex.en: A small spider was crawling across the ceiling.
A ceiling on annual rent increases could protect tenants, although it might discourage investment in housing.

col: set a ceiling on｜đặt mức trần cho
tip: ceiling là trần trong phòng; roof là mái bên ngoài tòa nhà.

senses.en: quiet and calm, without disturbance or worry
not involving war, violence, or fighting

ex.en: The lake looks peaceful in the early morning light.
Creating peaceful public spaces can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage more people to spend time outdoors.

col: peaceful protest｜cuộc biểu tình ôn hòa
tip: Có thể tả môi trường yên tĩnh, cũng có thể nói hành động không dùng bạo lực.

senses.zh: trí tưởng tượng; sự tưởng tượng
senses.en: The ability to form mental pictures or invent new ideas.

ex.en: With a little imagination, this box becomes a spaceship.
Creative activities encourage children to use their imagination and approach unfamiliar problems from different perspectives.

col: vivid imagination｜trí tưởng tượng phong phú
capture the imagination｜gợi trí tưởng tượng
a figment of the imagination｜điều tưởng tượng
tip: imaginative là giàu trí tưởng tượng; imaginary là tưởng tượng, không có thật.

senses.en: not kind or welcoming towards others
making an activity difficult or causing harm

ex.en: The new neighbour seemed unfriendly but was simply shy.
An unfriendly working environment can discourage employees from sharing ideas and seeking support.

col: unfriendly atmosphere｜bầu không khí lạnh nhạt
unfriendly attitude｜thái độ không thân thiện
environmentally unfriendly｜gây hại cho môi trường
tip: Dù kết thúc bằng -ly, đây thường là tính từ, không phải trạng từ.

senses.en: The loud sound in the sky caused by lightning
Produce thunder or make a similarly loud, deep noise

ex.en: A sudden clap of thunder made the windows shake.
Outdoor sports events should be suspended when thunder indicates that a storm is dangerously close.

col: a clap of thunder｜một tiếng sấm
a rumble of thunder｜tiếng sấm rền
tip: thunder là tiếng sấm, thường không đếm được; lightning là tia chớp.

senses.zh: thách thức; nhiệm vụ khó khăn
senses.en: A difficult task or situation that tests someone's abilities.
Question whether something is true, fair, or acceptable.
Invite someone to compete or test their abilities.

ex.en: Cooking dinner for twelve guests was quite a challenge.
Providing affordable housing remains a major challenge for cities experiencing rapid population growth and rising land prices.

col: face a challenge｜đối mặt với thách thức
meet a challenge｜vượt qua thử thách
challenge an assumption｜nghi ngờ một giả định
challenge someone to a contest｜thách ai tham gia cuộc thi
tip: Làm động từ, challenge đi thẳng với quan điểm, nghĩa là nghi ngờ nó.

senses.en: A small cup with a handle, used for drinking tea.

ex.en: She placed a delicate teacup beside the biscuit plate.
A museum display of decorated teacups can reveal how domestic tastes and manufacturing techniques changed over time.

col: a teacup and saucer｜tách trà và đĩa lót
a storm in a teacup｜chuyện bé xé ra to
tip: teacup là cái tách trà; a cup of tea là một tách trà.

senses.en: to transfer files from a device to an online system

senses.zh: sự tải lên; tệp được tải lên
senses.en: the transfer of a file online, or the file itself

ex.en: I uploaded our picnic photos to a shared folder.
Students can upload their assignments to a secure platform, allowing teachers to provide timely feedback.

col: upload to a server｜tải lên máy chủ
tip: Tải lên là upload, tải xuống là download; tải lên nơi nào dùng to.

senses.en: A small piece of soft paper used for wiping.
A group of similar cells performing a particular bodily function.

ex.en: She handed me a tissue when I sneezed.
Scientists are developing new treatments that help damaged tissue recover more effectively after an injury.

col: a box of tissues｜một hộp khăn giấy
tip: Khăn giấy là danh từ đếm được; mô sinh học thường không đếm được.

senses.en: something said or written to express information or an opinion
a formal public announcement about a particular matter
a record showing financial transactions over a period

ex.en: Her statement about the broken window surprised everyone.
The council issued a statement explaining how the proposed transport scheme would benefit residents with limited mobility.

col: make a statement｜đưa ra tuyên bố
issue a statement｜đưa ra thông cáo
a bank statement｜sao kê ngân hàng
a witness statement｜lời khai của nhân chứng
tip: Nghĩa phát biểu là danh từ đếm được; sao kê ngân hàng cũng dùng statement.

senses.zh: cô dâu; cô dâu sắp cưới
senses.en: A woman who is getting married or has just married.

ex.en: The bride held fresh flowers as she entered the garden.
In many cultures, the bride and her family share responsibility for organising the wedding celebration.

col: bride and groom｜cô dâu và chú rể
a beautiful bride｜một cô dâu xinh đẹp
tip: bride là cô dâu, groom là chú rể.

senses.en: unable to understand something or think clearly
unclear or difficult to follow because of poor organisation

ex.en: I felt confused when both doors led outside.
Students may become confused if teachers introduce too many unfamiliar concepts in a single lesson.

col: a confused account｜một lời kể lộn xộn
tip: confused mô tả người bối rối; confusing mô tả điều gây bối rối.

senses.en: Not often; on very few occasions.

ex.en: We rarely eat outside when the weather turns cold.
People living in remote villages rarely have easy access to specialist medical services.

col: rarely ever｜hầu như không bao giờ
tip: Thường đặt trước động từ thường, sau động từ be; bản thân từ đã mang nghĩa phủ định.

senses.zh: sự đặt chỗ; việc đặt trước
senses.en: An arrangement to keep a room, seat, or table available.

senses.zh: sự e ngại; ý kiến bảo lưu
senses.en: A doubt that prevents complete acceptance of something.

ex.en: I made a reservation for dinner by the window.
Some residents expressed reservations about the proposed airport expansion because of increased noise pollution.

col: have reservations about｜còn e ngại về
tip: Khi chỉ sự e ngại thường dùng số nhiều: have reservations about.

senses.zh: mức tối thiểu; lượng ít nhất
senses.en: The smallest amount or level possible or allowed.
Being the smallest amount or level possible or allowed.

ex.en: Please keep the noise to a minimum tonight.
A higher minimum wage may improve living standards for workers in low-paid service jobs.

col: keep something to a minimum｜giữ ở mức tối thiểu
tip: a minimum of + số lượng nghĩa là ít nhất bấy nhiêu.

senses.en: a public statement giving people information or news

ex.en: We heard an announcement about our train being delayed.
The government's announcement of additional education funding was welcomed by teachers and parents.

col: make an announcement｜đưa ra thông báo
tip: Đưa ra thông báo dùng make an announcement.

senses.en: A body part or aircraft structure that enables flight.
A section extending from the main part of a building.
A group within an organisation sharing particular views or aims.

ex.en: The bird stretched its wings before leaving the branch.
The hospital's new wing will provide additional beds and specialist facilities for the region's growing population.

col: spread your wings｜tung cánh; mở rộng chân trời
tip: Cánh chim và cánh máy bay đều là wing, thường có đôi nên hay dùng số nhiều.

senses.en: A hard pointed growth on the head of some animals.
A device on a vehicle that makes a loud warning sound.
A musical instrument played by blowing into a tube.

ex.en: The goat caught its horn in the fence.
Frequent use of car horns contributes to noise pollution and reduces residents' quality of life.

col: a pair of horns｜một cặp sừng
tip: Sừng động vật và còi xe đều là horn, đều đếm được.

senses.en: an artificial waterway for boats or carrying water
a narrow passage inside the body

ex.en: We watched a narrow boat glide along the canal.
Restoring historic canals can attract tourists while providing valuable habitats for wildlife in densely populated urban areas.

tip: canal thường là đường nước nhân tạo; river là sông tự nhiên.

senses.zh: động vật hoang dã; sinh vật hoang dã
senses.en: Animals and other living things in their natural surroundings.

ex.en: We watched the wildlife quietly from behind the trees.
Protecting wildlife requires governments to preserve natural habitats and limit development in environmentally sensitive areas.

col: protect wildlife｜bảo vệ động vật hoang dã
wildlife conservation｜bảo tồn động vật hoang dã
a wildlife reserve｜khu bảo tồn động vật hoang dã
tip: Danh từ không đếm được; trong wildlife park, wildlife đóng vai trò bổ nghĩa.
